description: Save several videos at once: a list of URLs, playlists or channels (expanded up to limit), each as video, audio or captions only. Failed items are reported and do not stop the rest. zip: true returns one .zip with every file. Video formats: mp4, webm, mkv; audio: mp3, m4a, opus, flac, wav; captions: srt, vtt, ass, ttml, sbv, lrc, csv, txt, json, markdown, original. Download only media you have the rights to: your own uploads, public-domain or Creative Commons works, or videos the site lets you download.

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

format.description: Format for that kind, e.g. mp4, mp3 or srt

kind.description: What each video becomes. Default video

limit.description: Most videos in total. Default and cap: VID2CONTEXT_MAX_PLAYLIST_ITEMS

playlist.description: Expand video links that also name a playlist (watch?v=...&list=...)

urls.description: Video, playlist or channel URLs, YouTube ids or file paths

zip.description: Return one .zip with every saved file

name: download_batch
title: Download many videos, audio or captions
